say:0:1221107001:0.text: Magister, see what Chippy's found—a gorgeous shell!
say:0:1221107001:0.source_cn: 主人，你看，满满捡到了一个好漂亮的贝壳！
say:0:1221107001:0.male: Magister, see what Chippy's found—a gorgeous shell!
say:0:1221107001:0.female: Magister, see what Chippy's found—a gorgeous shell!

say:1:1221107002:0.text: This is odd... There are so many shells here, but there's not a sign of rainbow snapper.
say:1:1221107002:0.source_cn: 好奇怪……这里的贝壳好多，但完全没有幻彩鲷的踪影。

say:2:1221107003:0.text: How about we ask the glimmerblooms? We can offer them the shells Chippy found to thank them!
say:2:1221107003:0.source_cn: 要不然去问问荧荧花吧？顺便把满满捡到的贝壳送给它们当作感谢！
